ac.title: Armor Class (AC)
ac.text: An attack meets or beats AC to hit. Kief’s AC is 15; Shield raises it to 20 until his next turn. A total of 20 still hits, and Shield does not cancel a critical hit.

dc.title: Spell save DC
dc.text: The target rolls a saving throw against this number. Use DC 14, or DC 15 for Sorcerer spells while Innate Sorcery is active. You do not also roll a spell attack.

attack.title: Spell attack +6
attack.text: Roll d20 +6 and report the total to hit. This already includes Charisma and proficiency. On a Fire Bolt hit, roll 2d10 damage; do not add the +6 to damage.

save.title: Constitution save +7
save.text: After damage while concentrating, roll d20 +7. The DC is 10 or half the damage rounded down, whichever is higher, capped at 30. Taking 26 damage means DC 13.

movement.title: Movement and initiative
movement.text: Ordinary movement is 30 feet; you can split it around your actions. Initiative is d20 +2 for turn order. Ask the DM about terrain and cover when positioning is unclear.

hp.title: Hit Points (HP)
hp.text: Track HP remaining out of 47. Damage and a concentration save are separate updates. At 0 HP, alert the table immediately; Unconsciousness ends concentration. Track death saves with the DM.

sp.title: Sorcery Points (SP)
sp.text: A separate pool of 5 points. Careful or Subtle costs 1 SP per casting. At level 5 you cannot combine those two on one casting. Innate Sorcery does not make Metamagic free.

slots.title: Spell slots
slots.text: Filled counters are slots remaining: 4 / 3 / 2 when fully rested. Spend a slot of the spell’s level or higher. Cantrips use no slot. A prepared spell stays prepared after casting.

innate.title: Innate Sorcery
innate.text: Activate with a Bonus Action and spend one of two uses. For 1 minute, Sorcerer DC becomes 15 and Sorcerer spell attacks have advantage. Roll two d20s, keep the higher, then add +6. Track the minute at the table.

hitDice.title: Hit Dice
hitDice.text: During a completed Short Rest, each spent Hit Die heals 1d6 +4, up to 47 HP. Mark the dice spent and adjust HP separately. Kief has five d6 Hit Dice when fully rested.

rest.title: Rest and recovery
rest.text: A pause in play is not automatically a rest. A Short Rest is at least 1 hour; restoration can recover up to 2 spent SP once per Long Rest. Ordinary slots and Innate uses stay spent. Confirm a completed Long Rest before resetting.

action.title: Action
action.text: One ordinary Action on your turn: cast an Action spell, Dodge, or work on the objective. An unused Action is fine. Holding a useful concentration spell does not itself cost an Action.

bonus.title: Bonus Action
bonus.text: At most one, when a feature or spell grants it. Innate Sorcery and Misty Step both use it, so choose one. You do not have to spend every available piece of your turn.

reaction.title: Reaction
reaction.text: Shield, Feather Fall, and Counterspell compete for the same Reaction. Use one when its trigger happens; it returns at the start of Kief’s next turn. You also need the required slot.

turnSlot.title: One slot per turn
turnSlot.text: In the 2024 rules, expend at most one spell slot to cast a spell per turn. Misty Step + Fire Bolt works; slotted Misty Step + slotted Fireball does not. A Reaction on your own turn shares this limit.

concentration.title: Concentration
concentration.text: Keep one concentration effect running. Starting another ends the first; agree on a landing before replacing Fly. Track the spell name. Damage calls for a save, and becoming Incapacitated ends concentration.

components.title: Spell components
components.text: V means spoken words, S gestures, M materials. A component pouch covers ordinary materials; priced or consumed materials must be supplied. Kief’s gear, including Chromatic Orb’s 50+ GP diamond, is pending.

method.title: Casting method
method.text: A higher slot can power a lower-level spell; added benefits depend on its text. A permitted Ritual takes 10 extra minutes and spends no slot. Components still apply. Review the costs before confirming a cast.

familiar.title: Mr. Big’s campaign ruling
familiar.text: Mr. Big is a physical, intelligent companion. Death is permanent loss and harms Kief; he will not willingly sacrifice himself. His final stats, 0-HP rules, and inherited familiar mechanics remain pending.
